record.summary: A spec can cite another repository's spec only in prose, so the citation cannot go stale visibly. This declares a cross-corpus interface reference pinned to a digest the exporting corpus already computes, so a moved interface is a detectable fact. Discovery, fetching and trust in the exporter stay outside. Deferred: specified now, built when a consumer names the need.
record.title: An interface reference is digest-pinned
